title: Blocked Route 29 Walk stays live with the saved Mankey follower

verification.actor: The unchanged save's current FOLLOWER Mankey (species 56) on Route 29, map 67.
verification.trigger: Continue from unchanged test.sav at (564,392), hold LEFT for 120 game frames until the player reaches the blocked tile (538,392), then hold LEFT for 240 more game frames.
verification.observable: The same current Mankey remains bound and presented; the player reaches and remains at (538,392); 360 completed game frames advance without an ARM9 abort or main-loop stall.

setupMutations.change: The shared worker copies test.nds and unchanged test.sav. No teleport, party edit, spawn, population edit, or state repair.

limits: This is the measured Route 29 blocked-step abort trigger. It does not prove all collision directions or other saves.
A setup mismatch, missing current Mankey, missing completed frame, ARM9 fault, or change from the blocked player tile fails.

events.value: Check the saved Route 29 start and bind the current Mankey follower.
Hold LEFT for 120 completed frames and check the blocked tile.
Keep LEFT held for 240 more completed frames; retain every main-loop sample.

stop.condition: 360 completed held-left frames at the blocked tile, or the first identity, player position, ARM9, or main-loop fault.

invariants: The same source-checked FOLLOWER Mankey stays current and attached throughout the 360-frame run
The saved player starts at Route 29 (564,392), reaches (538,392) within 120 LEFT frames, then stays there through 240 further LEFT frames
Every completed main-loop frame advances with no ARM9 abort or stalled queue
